'''Jimmy Corley''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[April 2002 Texas tournament]] on 21 April 2002 with Death Star II sealed (Kessel, Battle Order), according to Brian Wright's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3602">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-04-24-wrights-anticlimatic-return-4-21-02d3602/ wrights-anticlimatic-return-4-21-02], DeckTech (Brian "Bean2213" Wright, 24 April 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-04-24-wrights-anticlimatic-return-4-21-02d3602/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
